data.jobspec:
#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   --partition=physical
#   --time=0-0:10:00
#   --nodes=1
#   --ntasks=1

#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=10m

# Omitted Slurm option: --partition=physical
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run with different limits/priority or on different hardware (or be rejected by policy).

module load Python/3.5.2-goolf-2015a

echo "Cluster and Cloud Computing Assignment1 using 1 node and 1 core"

# Slurm script used mpiexec; under Flux, use flux-run.
time flux run -n 1 -c 1 python3 HPCInstagramGeoProcessingUsingMPI.py melbGrid.json bigInstagram.json

reasons: The original Slurm job specified a partition (`--partition=physical`) but the Flux resource section has no queue/partition selection; on sites where this affects eligibility/limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected.

inputs.script:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --partition=physical
#SBATCH --time=0-0:10:00
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1

# Load required modules
module load Python/3.5.2-goolf-2015a

# Execute Python Job on 1 node and 1 core
echo "Cluster and Cloud Computing Assignment1 using 1 node and 1 core"
time mpiexec python3 HPCInstagramGeoProcessingUsingMPI.py melbGrid.json bigInstagram.json
